told_after: I could not read 607 problems alone when I met them; now I can read 67 of them alone (67 with my own reader).

Where I am weak: stories I do not know how to put together yet (346 problems), questions asked in a way I do not know yet (74 problems), telling who a "he", "she" or "they" is (36 problems), stories in which an amount seemed not to be given (32 problems), numbers in a story that I do not know how to use (28 problems), comparisons and differences whose two sides I could not tell (13 problems), stories my reading got wrong (solving or checking it showed that) (10 problems), patterns (1 problem).

What I want to learn: stories I do not know how to put together yet (for example: "Jae bought 12 cartons of ice cream and 3 cartons of yogurt. Each carton of ice cream cost $9 and each carton of yogurt cost $2. How much more did Jae spend on ice cream than on yogurt?"); questions asked in a way I do not know yet (for example: "I am planting 50 apple trees and 30 peach trees. I want the same number and type of trees per row. What is the maximum number of trees I can plant per row?"); telling who a "he", "she" or "they" is (for example: "Tom saw that Michael has the rare robot that would complete one of his robot sets. Michael offered to sell it but he said that Tom will need to pay 3 times the original price. If the rare robot has an original price of $3.00, how much should Tom pay?").

life_story: 36 experiences in its life with its parents (soul events 1-36).
It learned from what its parents agreed on 4 times.
From each parent, what held up / what failed: chatgpt 6/2, claude 6/2, gemini 6/2.
It withheld an answer rather than guess 2 times.
It solved alone with something it had learned, the first time for that wording, 2 times.
Looking back on readings it could not judge at the time, once it had learned the wording, right / wrong: chatgpt 2/2, claude 2/2, gemini 2/2.
It noticed it had grown 4 times: it could read alone a problem it could not read alone before.
